summary: Pega CodeIntelligence: rules/query strips '@baseclass' appliesTo -> 0 results; short insKey 404 on custom service
rootCause: Custom service /api/CodeIntelligence/v1/rules/query matches appliesTo EXACTLY: empty -> 0 results, '@baseclass' -> found. Client (PegaRuleReadClient.getObject) stripped '@baseclass' to empty. Additionally /rules/instance requires the FULL pzInsKey (with #timestamp); short keys 404. Query result rows are handle-only (no content) -> need instance follow-up with full pzInsKey for full rule content.
